Subject: Launch support package & trial extension

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at SkyForge is excited about Redwood's inference performance. We ran a quick internal pilot and attached a short results summary. A couple of asks from our side as we prepare to move into a production evaluation: 

- Can you provide a 45-day extension to our trial so we can complete integration testing across two environments?
- Would Redwood consider a one-time $10k credit toward inference usage for the launch month (we'll be migrating ~4 production endpoints)?
- We're also exploring listing Redwood in the SkyForge Marketplace; any co-marketing or listing support would help expedite our internal approvals.

Procurement will need formal confirmation of any credits and term changes to proceed with an MOU. I've copied procurement (procurement@skyforge.com) for visibility and attached the pilot summary.

Appreciate any flexibility — happy to jump on a quick call.

Best,
Sofia Vega
Head of AI Partnerships
SkyForge Systems

Hi Sofia — great to hear the pilot went well and thanks for the notes. I reviewed the results with the Solutions team. Quick proposed terms to unblock procurement: 

- 45-day trial extension (no change to data or security posture)
- $10,000 one-time usage credit applied to first billing period after conversion
- 10% launch discount on list price for the first 3 months in exchange for a SkyForge Marketplace listing and a joint case study commitment within 90 days

These are exceptions to our standard onboarding package, so I'll need exec sign-off on the credit + discount bundle. I'm copying Marissa and Aditya for approval — if they greenlight, I'll send a short MOU and a DocuSign link for signature.

If procurement needs any additional paperwork, please share and I'll route to Legal.

Thanks — talk soon.

— Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

Marissa / Aditya — forwarding SkyForge ask. Summary: 45-day extension + $10k credit + 10% launch discount for 3 months in exchange for marketplace listing and joint case study. Deal: SF-2026-088, expected ARR ramp if conversion happens. Pilot looks solid (attached).

Why this matters: SkyForge is a strategic target in the cloud migration vertical; marketplace listing could shorten future procurement cycles. Concession is ~one-time and de-risks adoption if we tie the credit to onboarding milestones.

Requested approval: exception to standard promo caps to offer combined credit + discount as outlined. If approved I'll prepare an MOU and DocuSign. Also let me know if we should loop finance/legal before I send terms externally.

Quick ask: can we approve on this thread by end of day Monday so procurement can move?

Thanks,
Priyom

Priyom — thanks for the context. I support a one-time $10k credit + 45-day extension with the 10% launch discount for the first 3 months, conditional on the following: 

1) Procurement signs an MOU capturing the credit amount and the Marketplace commitment (case study timing, logo use).
2) Finance confirms the credit is booked as a one-time contra-revenue item and cannot be used against other bills. Laura, please advise on the booking/Q4 impact.
3) Legal to sign off on the joint marketing language (I'll ask Solutions to share the draft).

Aditya — please confirm pricing approval (this is outside the standard promo matrix) and, if OK, I'll authorize Priyom to proceed to DocuSign. Priyom, please include a clear milestone: credit applied only after go-live verification and marketplace listing confirmation within 90 days.
